entries.title: Darkest Dungeon
entries.definitive_edition: Darkest Dungeon on Windows PC with full DLC set

emulation.notes: Use the native PC release with all DLC installed; no emulation is needed.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native Windows PC presentation with full DLC/mod support.

primary.version: Current PC release with full DLC set
primary.why: The Windows PC route is the best archive version because it covers the base game, the major DLC set, Steam Workshop support, and the Butcher's Circus mode while preserving PC capture/settings flexibility. Console, handheld, iPad, and Switch routes are useful access options, but PC is the cleanest complete route.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Darkest Dungeon on Steam or GOG for Windows PC, install The Crimson Court, The Shieldbreaker, The Color of Madness, The Musketeer, and The Butcher's Circus content, then start the main archive run.

all_releases.fidelity: Native PC release with full DLC availability, Steam Workshop support, and the Butcher's Circus mode.
all_releases.reason: primary: most complete route with PC capture/settings flexibility.
skip: same desktop family, but Windows remains the preferred capture/settings target.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: PC is both the preferred capture route and the most complete route when all DLC and Butcher's Circus content are installed.

entries.remaster_caveats: Ancestral Edition bundles major DLC on some platforms, but PC with all DLC installed is the fullest archive route and preserves Workshop/mod access.

entries.title: Darkest Dungeon II
entries.definitive_edition: Darkest Dungeon II Resolute-style PC route with Binding Blade, Inhuman Bondage, and Kingdoms

emulation.notes: Use the native PC release with DLC and current update installed; no emulation is needed.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native Windows PC presentation with current DLC and Kingdoms content.

primary.version: Current PC release with Binding Blade, Inhuman Bondage, and Kingdoms
primary.why: The Windows PC route is the best archive version because it covers the full released game, the paid Binding Blade and Inhuman Bondage DLC, and the free Kingdoms mode while preserving PC capture/settings flexibility. Console and macOS routes are documented access options, but no sourced platform-exclusive gameplay content over PC is documented.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Darkest Dungeon II on Steam or GOG for Windows PC, install the current build plus The Binding Blade and Inhuman Bondage DLC, and make sure the free Kingdoms mode update is present.

all_releases.fidelity: Native PC full release with current DLC and Kingdoms update support.
all_releases.reason: primary: complete current route with PC capture/settings flexibility.
skip: same core content route as PC; Windows remains the preferred capture/settings target.

all_releases.fidelity: PlayStation console release across PS4 and PS5.
all_releases.reason: skip: console route, but no sourced platform-exclusive gameplay content over Windows PC.
skip: portable route, but no sourced platform-exclusive gameplay content over Windows PC.

all_releases.fidelity: Xbox console release across Xbox One and Xbox Series X|S.
all_releases.reason: skip: console route, but no sourced platform-exclusive gameplay content over Windows PC.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: The current PC route supports the released paid DLC and free Kingdoms mode; no platform-exclusive gameplay content is documented elsewhere.

entries.remaster_caveats: The Resolute Edition/complete bundle framing matters because the base game alone omits paid DLC; Kingdoms is a free mode update and should be present in the current build.
